description: Each render sees fixed state values. Handlers and timers created in that render keep using them.
React groups all state updates from one event (or task, since React 18) into a single re-render.
`setCount((previous) => previous + 1)` computes the next state from the latest queued value.
Setter calls are queued and processed in order during the next render.
`flushSync(() => setX(...))` from `react-dom` forces a synchronous update. Rarely needed.
